text: 财报季乐观预期与中东风险交织，美股三大指数涨跌互现，存储芯片股重挫；油价走高，黄金下跌。 中国财政部：自2027年4月1日起新能源汽车增值税出口退税率由13%下调至9%，同步取消电子烟设备装置等产品出口退税。 中国商务部称，中欧混动汽车贸易安排不会专门针对中国产品，中方配额不低于欧方其他任何进口来源地。 特朗普称俄乌双方均违反能源停火安排。 沙特面临新一轮无人机和巡航导弹袭击，多艘空载超级油轮避开波斯湾。 诺贝尔经济学奖揭晓：两位学者重新诠释凯恩斯理论，为宏观稳定政策奠定微观基础。 AI算力需求爆发，联讯仪器前三季度净利润同比预增1866%至2073%。
text_en: Optimistic earnings-season expectations intertwined with Middle East risks, with the three major US stock indexes closing mixed and memory chip stocks sharply lower; oil prices rose and gold fell. China's Ministry of Finance: starting April 1, 2027, the VAT export tax rebate rate for new energy vehicles will be lowered from 13% to 9%, while export tax rebates for products such as e-cigarette devices will also be canceled. China's Ministry of Commerce said the China-EU hybrid vehicle trade arrangement will not specifically target Chinese products, and China's quota will be no lower than that of any other EU import source. Trump said both Russia and Ukraine have violated the energy ceasefire arrangement. Saudi Arabia faces a new round of drone and cruise missile attacks, and multiple empty supertankers avoided the Persian Gulf. The Nobel Prize in Economics was announced: two scholars reinterpreted Keynesian theory, laying a microeconomic foundation for macroeconomic stabilization policy. AI computing power demand exploded, and Lianxun Instruments preliminarily expects net profit for the first three quarters to increase 1866% to 2073% year on year.
